programme.title: 非洲獵人 #1 英普
programme.desc: 當家族中的雄獅都在探索鄰近的領土時,姆萬巴獅群中的狩獵責任就落在九位強壯的母獅身上看看她們如何應對雨季的來臨,還要忙於照顧六隻不斷成長且胃口無限的幼獅

programme.title: 大貓國度 #1
programme.desc: 在盧安瓜谷,強大的孟巴肯高獅群仍有17頭壯獅,但老化的雄性領導無以為繼在北方,荷里活獅群中的六隻雌獅已經自給自足了三年,但沒有雄性與她們交配,可能導致族群滅絕四名年輕流浪雄獅突然的造訪,似乎回應著荷里活獅群的祈禱

programme.title: 明猩學園 #3
programme.desc: 4歲的班尼和娜娜因在森林裡發生了一次意外,班尼腿部骨折,娜娜肘部骨折,所以被收容在明猩學園的診所不能走路並不能阻止「徘佪者」班尼,牠在房間裡拖動著身體,大聲要求牛奶和擁抱

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在南非,春天在九月初顯現端倪,大自然生氣盎然白晝漸長,氣溫升高萬物復蘇,生機勃勃

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #2 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的夏天是極端的季節,它劃分出了弱者與强者它考驗著獵豹,獅子,壁虎,海龜和更多物種在酷熱的夏天尋找食物和水的生存本能

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #3
programme.desc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚

programme.title: 深入澳大利亞 #1
programme.desc: 探索北領地的海岸和大堡礁豐富的水域資源跟隨主持人莉茲穿越被淹沒的道路,碰見飢餓的鹽水鱷魚和水母,並查探眾多奇怪的致命生物為何會以這個偏遠地區為家

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #5 英普
programme.desc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球

programme.title: 深入內地 英普
programme.desc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性

programme.title: 大貓國度 #3
programme.desc: 四頭流浪雄獅組成的暴力團,正尋找可接管的獅群他們在盧安瓜河的西岸徘徊,並已跟北方的荷里活雌獅群大打一場,現正南下進入強大的孟巴肯高獅群的地盤孟巴肯高的雌獅群的狩獵隊阻止他們接近,但她們的策略只能持續幾天

programme.title: 明猩學園 #5

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc: Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye She packs her bags and sets off nnNew York’s signature street food is the hot dog In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會
programme.desc: 由「愛基金」主辦、「創世電視」協辦的「一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會」,聯合不同教會的力量,加上演藝人的見證,將福音帶給香港市民。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-羅馬書看信仰生活化的挑戰
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從羅馬書看基督徒的個人信仰,如何做到「入世而出世」;肢體間如果做到恩賜配搭、彼此相愛,並探討基督徒在社會的參與、生活倫理、奉獻及差傳等等。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 鋼琴大師的生命樂章
programme.desc: 巴哈, 莫劄特, 貝多芬, 蕭邦 - 四位誇越時代的鋼琴大師,在他們的生命樂章裏面,上帝的音符不斷跳動,並且影響後世無數音樂家。國際知名鋼琴家Sandra Wright Shen,曾獲得多個國際鋼琴大賽的冠軍,她將會為我們分享四位鋼琴大師的信仰故事。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:「信」者無懼 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影專線:翻生奇兵

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-羅馬書看信仰生活化的挑戰
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從羅馬書看基督徒的個人信仰,如何做到「入世而出世」;肢體間如果做到恩賜配搭、彼此相愛,並探討基督徒在社會的參與、生活倫理、奉獻及差傳等等。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-唔做黑幫做牧師
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-羅馬書看信仰生活化的挑戰
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從羅馬書看基督徒的個人信仰,如何做到「入世而出世」;肢體間如果做到恩賜配搭、彼此相愛,並探討基督徒在社會的參與、生活倫理、奉獻及差傳等等。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:「信」者無懼 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 程蒙恩長老-初信成長2
programme.desc: 在你接受耶穌那一刻,一個新生命已經在你裡面誕生。你瞭解這個新生命的身份和地位嗎?你希望過上嶄新的生活嗎?你渴望更認識上帝和聖經嗎?就讓程蒙恩長老和你一起走上這條信徒成長之路。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:神大能的手保護你 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大

香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#144粵
programme.desc: 義為圓當賽車手夢想私下學車，但因看到花手中公仔而失控撞車入院，花取笑義技術差勁，更揭發義受傷原因。喜於是道出義因童年陰影，致每次看到這種公仔時，必定會大失常性，花聽後，內心難安，決定助有義克服陰影。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#19粵普PG
programme.desc: 雪寧想到很多事情都沒有改變，疑惑究竟是否該執意與張遮在一起。尤夫人為芳吟籌謀婚事，想藉此抵債，芳吟極不情願；呂顯想到辦法協助芳吟脫離尤家。謝危先發制人，直接對薛遠談及定非的事，讓薛遠無法下手對付自己…

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 卓正醫療呈獻：全家健康攻略粵
食平DD粵
programme.desc: 今集以醋入饌！來自台灣的天下第一薑有甚麼來頭？炮製薑醋關鍵在於配料能否凸顯醋香，黃耳木耳齋薑醋正是絕佳的示範。肥媽一尾兩用，炮製牛尾湯及陳醋燴牛尾。並示範陳醋炸蛋，及傳授用攪拌機做港式糖水－楊枝甘露。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 放射診斷一般涵蓋電腦掃描、磁力共振、X光、超聲波等。放射診斷師指PCCT屬第五代的電腦掃描，比起傳統技術有甚麼優勢？它特別適合心臟病或癌症患者，進行前有何要準備？又有甚麼限制？嘉賓羅家英笑言從母親懷孕期間已醞釀粵劇細胞，並自小跟父親學戲，而最近出書自述生平，少不免提及粵劇在港的發展。家英哥自言沒特長，只能投身粵劇，也執意要將這藝術傳承下去。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓奉上色彩繽紛的「鮮粟米粒椰香帆立貝」。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 「灣區遊」壓軸一站來到深圳，先往龍崗區的大型商場，體驗一站式吃喝玩樂。唱K、打棒球、騎馬等，商場內都可玩到！品嚐海鮮餐，烤蝝、蒸黃油蟹，讓主持們大快朵頤。夜訪甘坑古鎮，內裡滿滿的打卡熱點，柏姸、凱文更化身「吹糖人」。向南頭古城前進，除可參觀新安縣衙門古蹟外，深入某間唱片店，竟找到一張麥包當封面的黑膠碟？柏姸、凱文還會換上唐風服飾，大吃麻辣火鍋。眾人再於星級酒店享用下午茶，細味「球王」美斯聯乘漢堡。

programme.title: 東坡家事#6粵PG
programme.desc: 閏之感激少游在蘇邁面前替她講好話。大妹接納東坡意思為扇舖換名。季常獲大妹贈扇，月娥醋意大發……東坡與閏之為大妹生爭執，嬌姐向東坡暗示閏之與少游眉來眼去。小妹找閏之被少游打暈；嬌姐決定與少游離開蘇家……

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 在南極走失的戴雅三人，為返回飛機接應的地點，繼續在冰天雪地艱難奮進。縱使有歌博士的特製內衣保暖，一旦限時過去，他們則無法抵受嚴寒。三人不斷徘徊，最終來到一個陌生的海岸，就在這時，腳下的冰竟突然裂開…

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 障礙競技將體操、運動攀登、跑酷(Parkour)三種元素結合，縱然帶有一定的危險性，但同時亦因為有難度，才會讓運動員充滿挑戰心。「Kids’ Notes」請來障礙競技運動員，介紹相關運動所用到的道具，並細說參與世界各地賽事的難忘點滴與得着。比賽亦設小朋友項目，小童運動員也會分享參賽心得。小朋友體重較輕，處理某些障礙或會比成年運動員更有優勢？此外，今集會播放《杯弓蛇影》的AI生成動畫上半部份。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄渴望發現寶藏一夜致富，多啦A夢借他「星球探測火箭」，嘗試尋找有寶藏的星球。大雄不願動卻又想去別處，多啦A夢借他「吸盤銅錢」，讓他可以像吸盤魚般黏在別人背後，不費氣力去到目的地。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 卓正醫療呈獻：全家健康攻略粵
programme.desc: 樓市回穩，帶動深井一帶呎價，由低位反彈，普遍已重上10,000元大關，後市能否繼續升？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
才駿HASHTAG 「私人財富」─ 財富+粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵
programme.desc: 資深藝人「四哥」謝賢今(20)日傳來離世消息，節目回顧其生前片段。「准許狗隻進食肆」措施已於指定近千間食肆實行，食肆遇上突發情況應如何處理？如狗隻便溺，店方又有權收取清潔費嗎？有男士在交友程式結識異性，對方提出借款，男方以為用錢可換來感情故答應，惟及後沒得到想要的，遂要求還錢。另邊廂，女方責男方是「恐怖情人」？一眾《愛．回家之開心速遞》演員拍攝大結局場面，又Rap又唱，送上花絮。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2854粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: Joe成為尋寶圖的話事人，若水等人為籌辦感謝祭加班工作，活動過後卻因Joe之故未獲補假，遂向璟風抱怨。璟風向Joe了解此事，終得知是力蓮從中阻撓，令Joe未能成功爭取相關補假，璟風遂提出特別的解決方法。Joe照辦，力蓮卻察覺不妥……Joe與力蓮的鬥爭持續升級，Joe設法討好敢威，力蓮仿效其手法出招，反勝一仗。Joe本欲反擊，卻因璟風的說話有所啟發，有意不再與力蓮相爭，奈何力蓮仍咄咄逼人……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#16粵PG
programme.desc: 文森發現曉善身上一件配飾，印有家仁辦公室找到襟章的相同標誌，更發現曉善與家仁是同校學生，開始對曉善展開調查。另一邊廂，潔清也表現得神化，在家仁死後急速辭職。文森查出潔清和曉善的母女關係，但依然未能查證高濃度硫化氫來源，以及曉善到底有否合謀。這時，曉善收到喜訊，表示有機會到外國治療，或可重新站起來！兩母女下定決心離港重過新生，想不到芯凌發現二人關係，對潔清大興問罪之師，甚至對潔清不利！

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 來到「北嶽」恆山，主持們相約「令狐沖掌門」呂頌賢見面。參觀依山而建的懸空寺，細賞古人的建築智慧。他們於茶舍茹素話當年，小說裡嗜酒如命的令狐沖，現實中卻是滴酒不沾。三人討論《笑傲江湖》內容，提到這是一部充滿悲劇的作品。頌賢坦言對令狐沖又愛又恨，因該角色幾乎霸佔了其演藝人生。雲岡石窟內，雄偉的釋迦牟尼坐像據說是按照北魏皇帝打造。享用大同的歷史美食，百花燒賣獲慈禧讚譽為天下第一籠、鳳趴窩亦深得太后歡心。

programme.title: 不眠日#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 在第三次循環，安嵐的行動軌跡改變，丁奇幫助她避過車禍，間接將沃力與墨馬的會面地點改為咖啡店，但咖啡店遭人丟煙霧彈，丁奇抓到犯人，竟是葉坤。墨遠致到大學進行演講，游玉祥以人質要挾，要求重新調查蔣育文案。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 卓正醫療呈獻：全家健康攻略粵
再創世紀#4粵PG
programme.desc: 澤雨痛失至親，到酒吧借酒澆愁。定垚為陪伴澤雨放棄前往布拉格，啟堂責她不夠成熟。松蔭與啟堂以公開天生資金來源逼他低價出讓天生天蔭股份，天生無奈答應。迷債苦主盧啟南綁架定垚，向啟堂勒索千萬。高哲決定辭職，離別前勸諫啟堂要為迷債苦主做點事，否則香港難以翻身。啟堂要兩子準備贖金，同時與各大銀行商議苦主補償方案。定垚明白啟南苦況，願意助他尋求賠償，但啟南堅持取贖金。啟南女兒餵食定垚時，突然抽搐並口吐白沫。

programme.desc: 三位主持到澳門旅遊塔測試膽色挑戰自己，林正峰能否成功爬上塔頂？何沛珈與陳楨怡玩雙人高飛跳，又能否克服高空離心力的恐懼？刺激過後到VR科技城享受打機樂趣，再到澳門大賽車博物館參觀，感受賽車氣氛之後熱血沸騰，駕駛小型賽車用速度鬥快鬥刺激！誰勝誰負？三人欣賞塗鴉壁畫又學整Graffiti T-Shirt，再參觀澳門不同廟宇，學習搓香感受傳統文化，坐開蓬巴士夜遊澳門，最後走入哈利波特展覽的魔法世界，進入電影場景的奇幻旅程。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 芭菲精靈笑臉迎接前來挑戰的男、女兵團，首先要兩隊接受「廠長話」考驗。男子組有成員因重心不穩，不慎於沒有「廠長話」指令下放低了腿。幸好芭菲精靈給予一次機會，才得以繼續遊戲。在神奇地壺關卡中，女子隊成功「加碼」，完成三個「收集」任務，男生們能否超越這成績？走過「溶化之橋」時，首位女生挑戰運送五個雪糕球未能成功，但她並未退縮，第二次仍勇敢選擇運送相同數量，並力求穩步到達終點……

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 毒菇城主木野小次郎竹高，想查明稗田八方齋秘密休養的原因。校長先生拜託亂太郎把一封燒焦了的信，帶去給金樂寺的大師。學期完結休假，大家都回家探親。小丸突然不捨得與亂太郎及新丁分開。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2855粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 力蓮原本與Joe相鬥，卻因某些緣故將矛頭轉向尚善，視她為最大威脅，但並未與尚善正面衝突，而是以其他方法試圖令她自動消失。尚善察覺異樣，並從力王口中得知一事，明白力蓮暗中搞小動作的真正原因；樹仁碰巧聽到二人對話，遂將事情告知熊家眾人，眾人大感高興！另一方面，潮偉找到金主投資拍攝新片，打算邀請尚善出任編劇，此時卻得知尚善留在接龍或會更上一層樓，遂希望她慎重考慮再下決定。尚善本已立定主意，詎料……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#17粵PG
programme.desc: 文森已找到曉善和家仁的衝突片段，正式拉曉善和潔清回去問話。然而，表面證據無法控告曉善合謀殺人，文森放虎歸山，令事情變得更明朗，潔清亦將一切和盤托出。文森細思案情，發現潔清、芯凌和逸思口供存着微微的矛盾，卻礙於表面證供成立，只能對潔清作出起訴。這時，為文森帶來頭緒的頻道再上載新影片，讓文森發現頻道是在復刻家仁生前的得意整蠱作品，表面是向家仁致敬，背後卻想將「閉氣挑戰」重演……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 山西汾酒被譽為四大名酒之一，師兄弟憑酒寄意，試為對方調配汾酒雞尾酒。黎耀祥提醒師弟「淡定D」，麥包則祝福師兄「有財又開心」？釀醋文化亦是山西的「武功絕學」，兩主持一探繁複講究的釀醋步驟，淺嚐不同年份的老陳醋，更以演戲需要時間醞釀來形容？平遙古城保存着明清時期的建築，時至今日仍有居民生活。師兄弟遊走這個「千年活古城」，解開古代票號兌換匯票的密碼，還會從晉商菜細味箇中歷史古韻，每一道佳餚都大有來頭！

programme.title: 不眠日#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 玉祥脅持人質遭方鷺槍殺，後來發現他持的是假刀，根本無意傷害人，讓方鷺後悔不已。外賣員傅駿在第三次循環中還是死去，讓丁奇感詫異。遠致憶述往事，認為當年育文妒忌自己。第四次循環中，丁奇奇怪地覺得自己死過…

再創世紀#5粵PG
programme.desc: 定垚救人受傷，擔心腳傷影響跳舞。天生拿着孝聰死前不雅短片，成功要脅松蔭將天蔭中心轉讓予明晞。澤雨氣憤不已，為了重振家族事業，毅然向定垚提出分手，定垚難以接受。天生、明晞手挽手走進天蔭中心，想起二人在此相識的經過，天生還向明晞求婚。高哲到溫哥華尋找思妤不果，黯然神傷，二人各自重遊舊地卻失之交臂。明晞不滿意富豪們都不出席婚宴，天生略耍手段令啟堂不得不出現，眾富豪亦聞風前往，而松蔭也突然現身婚宴……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 皮膚科醫生指蕁麻疹(風癩)的出現，原因多是感染或環境上的物理刺激，只有少數由食物引起，分急性和慢性，慢性亦有分自發性和誘發性，各自的治療方向有異。嚴重至甚麼程度要立刻求醫？此外，減壓是預防情況轉差的大前提！用自身血液可治療關節痛？骨科醫生概述PRP增生療法的原理，可針對肌腱與韌帶的發炎或撕裂，以及運動傷害。醫生細說治療流程，並提供日常的關節保養建議。「睇餸食飯」，鄭紫欣炮製「椰香印尼咖喱雞飯」。

programme.title: 玩盡澳門無限Fun粵
programme.desc: 三位愛玩的主持一大早跑步上東望洋炮台俯瞰澳門半島！不懂土風舞的主持變裝學跳舞，能否跳得似模似樣？跳到肚餓跟土生葡人廚師學煮土生菜，體驗地道文化又品嚐美味！到龍環葡韻參觀，感受昔日土生葡人生活方式，跟葡國磚藝術畫家學製手繪瓷磚過後，當然要享受大廚精心炮製的傳統葡國大餐，再到頂層酒吧學調Mocktail談心，互相分享真摯感受來結束這次豐富精彩的旅程。

programme.title: 東坡家事#8粵PG
programme.desc: 月娥逼大妹讓她入股一扇軒，更以催財為名在店內佈置風水陣，季常卻認出這是催病陣。王雱向東坡表示要憑本領應考科舉，東坡欣賞答應讓大妹嫁他，王蘇兩家會晤傾談婚事細節……為籌措大妹的嫁妝費，東坡減少應酬……

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 智悟一行潛入AI城市的住宅區，途中卻被系統發現，受到全城居民追捕。就在這時，據報失蹤的天才少年維辰竟現身相救。按維辰說法，出席奧丁社長演講的科研人員都被關進這座城市，作為他控制全人類計劃的第一步……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 小朋友或會對學習數學感疑惑，家長未必懂得解答。數學補習導師作客「Kids’ Notes」，提到數學對生活的重要，更指出令人感到沉悶的不是數學，而是數學練習！學數學可怎樣入手？試試隨父母入超市購物，已可連結到百分比、加減、折扣等知識；藉課外書了解數學家的歷史，也能從不同方向增加對學習的好奇心和趣味性。小學生常因大意而犯錯，尤其是抄錯數字或單位，建議做完題目後要複查。家長協助子女溫書，又有何注意事項？

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: BB超人來探訪叔果Jam叔他們。剛巧果Jam叔他們正準備前往雞蛋王國，BB超人於是一同上路。大碗飯三人組爭論哪一種飯最好吃。鑊仔飯人為了證明鑊仔飯��最好吃的，決定前往天狗之森採集野菇作為材料。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 卓正醫療呈獻：全家健康攻略粵

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
渣打香港呈獻：大灣區環球業務拓展高峰論壇粵
programme.desc: 《大灣區環球業務拓展高峰論壇》由渣打銀行全力策動、電視廣播有限公司主辦，邀請到香港特別行政區行政長官李家超親臨主禮並致開幕辭，並聯同渣打香港兼大中華及北亞區行政總裁禤惠儀及電視廣播有限公司行政主席許濤共同主持揭幕儀式。本次高峰會吸引約300名商界領袖及企業代表出席 ，與會者八成來自大灣區的企業創辦人或最高管理層。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2856粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵PG
programme.desc: 牙斬斬、李莫仇分別欲得到Bonnie、蔥頭，合作假裝情侶接近二人，並設法拆散鴛鴦。城安察覺不妥，查證後決定先下手為強，搶先促成蔥頭和Bonnie的婚事。蔥頭獲告知真相，城安、凌凌建議他與Bonnie前赴吳旺達，就可盡快成婚。蔥頭按計劃進行浪漫求婚儀式，卻因城安的過失而生出變故。蔥頭被判終身監禁，並被剝奪結婚權利。城安為救蔥頭作出各種嘗試，但屢屢碰壁。Bonnie最終向牙斬斬屈服，甘願犧牲……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#18粵PG
programme.desc: 文森認定該影片頻道跟家仁的死有關，全力調查背後操控者。文森發現該人更曾因為家仁導致流產，警方即鎖定該人全力通緝。頻道預告會重演「閉氣挑戰」，並針對某人復仇，文森趕往救人，卻發現中了圈套。然而頻道又再策劃一場驚天地、泣鬼神的大型直播整蠱，文森擔心會出意外到場勸止，但直播已經開始……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 壺口瀑布將山西、陝西以壯麗的黃河之水分隔，柯受良曾在這裡飛越黃河，原來此處景色會隨季節產生變化？山西運城市的解州關帝廟，建造格局貼近北京故宮，廟前四龍壁可證關公地位僅次於九五至尊！而運城的地道菜，大多與關帝有關，椒葉石子餅、羊湯如何跟關公拉上關係？風葫蘆則來自慈禧太后落難的故事，黎耀祥笑言其賣相非葫蘆型，有可能與他飾演的李連英有關？至於登上鸛雀樓觀日落，與置身風陵古渡前所見的落日，卻是兩種感覺。

programme.title: 不眠日#6粵普PG
programme.desc: 第四次循環中，丁奇揭開育文於爆炸中脫身真相，再託段崢調查Maggie資料。安嵐去臨終醫院追查婉清失蹤真相，被葉坤所擒，丁奇趕到與他火拼。丁奇向安嵐坦白自己是時間循環感知者，兩人潛入遠致實驗室，發現重大秘密…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

再創世紀#6粵PG
programme.desc: 2016年，欠下巨債的程凱成功游說債主借貸投資其新發明，其女友阮令翹重申只想他腳踏實地工作，放棄研發事業。傲堂股價急升，啟堂感不妥，認為是天生所為。澤雨向街坊宣傳大數據方向，表現獲讚好，在董事會上卻觸礁，松蔭鼓勵他先行搞好眾籌平台的初創比賽。傲堂董事陸一山之子在英國惹上官非，學禮主動幫忙，條件是出讓傲堂股份。定垚與澤雨相遇，相約晚飯。定垚悉心打扮，突然接到兩位哥哥遇意外喪生消息，可是聯絡不上父親…

programme.title: 高朋滿座#146粵
programme.desc: 亨對美食全無興趣，被證實患上厭食症。高家出盡法寶仍未令他恢愎食慾。麗說悅發現亨的情信，內容指他很掛念一個人，對方卻多番失約，連生日亦遺下他一人獨過。悅竟指信中人是麗，但實情是亨心中有另一個重要的人。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 沈玠私見姜雪蕙，被薛姝看到，未幾京中便流傳起姜雪寧在通州的風流韻事。姜伯游為了女兒，毅然在朝堂上參薛遠貪墨賑災糧款，張遮也將薛姝濫用興武衛職權散佈姜雪寧流言之事呈稟，沈琅大怒，命謝危與張遮徹查興武衛。

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.desc: 全新場景、全新比賽陣容、全新遊戲並結合世界各國的場景與關卡。考驗麻吉好友和團體的合作默契，一場場歡笑、緊張與刺激的團體競賽，陪伴大朋友小朋友週末的歡聚時光。

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: The Traveller: The House in the Wind
programme.desc: After the mysterious death of the Traveler, Captain Yann Kandinsky returns to the Ardennes, where he reopens a decade-old murder case that may be tied to two multiple unsolved killings.

programme.title: Margherita Hack - The Lady Of The Stars
programme.desc: The intimate and emotional biography of Italian astrophysicist Margherita Hack, from an independent and curious child to the first female director of the Trieste Astronomical Observatory.

programme.title: To My Beloved
programme.desc: Fernando is a good man who takes care of his only child, Daniel. Following the death of his wife Ana, every night Fernando recalls their love as he sorts out his beloved dead spouse’s belongings. One day he finds a VHS tape that will change everything.

programme.title: Coureur
programme.desc: Felix grows up exposed to the hedonistic lifestyle of his father’s veteran cycling races – alcohol and drugs. As a teenager, he is determined to become a pro and supersede his father. However, the cruel competition and his weak health threaten his dreams.

programme.title: Rival
programme.desc: 9-year-old Roman follows his mother Oksana, an illegal nurse in Germany. Oksana falls in love with 62-year-old Gert who tries to befriend Roman. While spending an afternoon alone with Roman, Gert suddenly dies of a heart attack, leaving Roman alone.

programme.title: Until Tomorrow
programme.desc: A single mother's courage is tested when she resorts to desperate measures to hide her illegitimate child from her parents.

programme.title: Murder in Guilvinec
programme.desc: A woman dressed as a mermaid is found dead on a deserted coast — and her DNA turns up on an abandoned fishing boat with no crew aboard. As the fisherman vanishes without a trace, a haunting mystery pulls two investigators into dangerous waters

programme.title: Wonderfully Beautiful
programme.desc: Ranging from a 60-year-old retiree who no longer finds herself desirable to a daughter trying to make her breakthrough as a model, five women of different ages confront their self-image and the expectation they have for themselves and the people around them.

programme.title: Mammal
programme.desc: Margaret (Rachel Griffiths), a silently grieving divorcee forms an intense bond with Joe (Barry Keoghan), a homeless youth. Their oedipal relationship is threatened by the wrath of Margaret’s ex-husband and Joe’s involvement with a gang of violent youths.

programme.title: Heavenly Nomadic
programme.desc: A family of nomads dwelling high in the mountains of Kyrgyzstan doesn't need any of the conveniences of modern civilization in order to be happy. But progress is creeping into their lives regardless, destroying legends and traditions as it comes.

programme.title: Risk Society
programme.desc: Courier driver Young Gil spirals into debt and desperation after squandering his casino winnings. Having pawned his truck away, Young Gil resorts to stealing a car to get to his fiancée, where a shocking discovery awaits him in the trunk.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Tablet Takeover
programme.desc: The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they've found. When they're not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Cold
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po are outside in the cold when they spot the Tiddlytubbies who are warm, inside. The Teletubbies put on hats, gloves and scarves to keep warm.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S07 - G
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'g', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We rock out on the guitar, meet a goat and score a goal!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Tiny Sandwiches
programme.desc: Messy joins Zim and his friends on a mission inside a sandwich to photograph some atoms for Mayor Oki... Everyone say cheese!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Happy Happy Valentines
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to deliver a superfun singing valentine. But the problem is, they don't know who it's for, or who it's from. Preston is racing to beat them to it!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Waitomo Glowworm Caves, New Zealand
programme.desc: It's not a good day to be a glow-worm, when Grandmaster Glitch goes in search of some disco sparkles in New Zealand. Can the Go Jetters stop him?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Bbq
programme.desc: It's lunchtime on Bluey's deck! But the BBQ needs a salad, so Bingo's relaxing sit-down will have to wait until she finds every colour of capsicum her cousins asked for!

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bingo
programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Prairie Dog Pups
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Chihuahua, Northern Mexico to discover how a colony of black tailed prairie dogs protect their pups from prowling bull snakes, hawks and coyotes as the pups take their critical first steps above ground.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Gloves
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie play a fun game of 'Wavey Wavey Snap' using some giant, silly gloves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Comic Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is reading the Squirrels one of his favourite comics. They eagerly want to know the ending, but the comic was discontinued. Luckily Duggee has the comic badge, he can show the Squirrels how to create their own ending.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Babysitting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a job to do outside of the Clubhouse. But who will look after the Squirrels? King Tiger of course, he has his Babysitting Badge. But then the Squirrels end up babysitting King Tiger!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The A Cappella Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are inspired to learn how to sing a cappella style after hearing a famous bird quartet singing in a nearby tree.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Cave Train Trouble, Slovenia
programme.desc: Glitch has taken Tala on holiday to Slovenia's Postojna Caves, and she is looking forward to finding a rare creature called an olm for her class project. Ubercorn and Lars join them.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Dream Team Trouble
programme.desc: After Glitch accidentally destroys part of the Academy, he and Ubercorn have a huge argument. When he heads to Grim HQ to make amends, Ubercorn is accidentally trapped as Glitch heads to the most remote place on earth: Point Nemo, in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. With the help of some friendly astronauts, Glitch and Ubercorn try to get a message to the Go Jetters before Grim HQ sinks to the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends S24 - Sonny's Second Chance
programme.desc: Sonny returns to Sodor to try to be a really useful engine again but some of the other trains aren't willing to give him a second chance.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Cloud Tower
programme.desc: A search for shade on a hot day leads Sarah and Duck to discover a fascinating tower in the park.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Sound Jumble
programme.desc: When Sarah hears some interesting music on the radio, she and Duck try to recreate it.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Painting
programme.desc: Stanley goes to help Myrtle, who has found a paint smudge on the Town Hall's door!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Circus
programme.desc: The cicrus bus has broken down, but the children are waiting for a circus show! Can Stanley help out?

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I'm An Actual Ninja You Know
programme.desc: From astronauts to acrobats, the animals talk about all the things they want to be when they grow up.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran S02 - It's Time to Visit the Aquarium
programme.desc: When JoJo is interested in all the beautiful fish that Gran Gran shows her on the tablet, Gran Gran has a plan. They can visit all the fish and sea creatures at the aquarium! Whilst there, JoJo is amazed by the fish and sea creatures. To top off their fun-filled day out, JoJo meets a special friend of Gran Gran's.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pass the Parcel
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Choreography Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out doing their exercises when suddenly, a cheetah called Chipo comes along with his dance crew. He criticises them for not being able to dance in time, and it turns out Duggee used to be part of the dance crew! Duggee was a great dancer, but he never stuck to the choreography and was always making up his own moves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Betty's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn't always enjoy playing. Since her first day at Squirrel Club, she always impressed everyone with her confidence and independence, but at first she didn't know how to join in with the others. Luckily, Duggee had a great idea to bring all the Squirrels together.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love…

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return…

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death – a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her…

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Bloody Escape
programme.desc: Ku is a skilled Kung Fu artist brought up by the bandits and does not agree with the brutal leader of the bandit's camp. He rescues Tong, a young lady forced to become the leader's wife, causing both the authorities and bandits to come after them. Ku has to stand up against the bandits that he grew up with so as to start a new life for himself.

programme.title: The Bloody Escape
programme.desc: Ku is a skilled Kung Fu artist brought up by the bandits and does not agree with the brutal leader of the bandit's camp. He rescues Tong, a young lady forced to become the leader's wife, causing both the authorities and bandits to come after them. Ku has to stand up against the bandits that he grew up with so as to start a new life for himself.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to “Shadow Whip”?

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the “walls”?

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her…

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin…

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out…

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident…

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship

She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles

Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Ip Man

Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Royal Tramp

As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Fight Back to School III

With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time

Can he take them down and uphold justice?

The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Parental Guidance
programme.desc: The Trollhunters are paused from action when their parents stage an intervention to get answers from the kids.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - The Oath
programme.desc: The Trollhunters race to stop Gunmar from acquiring a powerful relic, and Jim must do the unthinkable to stop him!

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Ill Gotten Gains
programme.desc: When Colonel Kubritz issues a medical quarantine that locks down the high school, Aja and Krel must avoid capture with help from their friends. Meanwhile Vex, Zadra, and Stuart have a run-in with a familiar face.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - There's Something About Gwen (of Gorbon)
programme.desc: When Stuart’s larger-than-life ex-girlfriend surprises him with a visit, Aja, Steve, Vex, and Nana join them on a triple date— where issues from each of their relationships come to a head. Meanwhile, Krel, Toby, and Eli discover a new passion: Sci-Fi filmmaking.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Asteroid Rage
programme.desc: With an asteroid hurdling toward Earth, threatening to destroy Arcadia Oaks, Aja and Krel must join forces with Area 49-B -- Colonel Kubritz and Tronos -- to stop it. These strange bedfellows might save the town, but this alliance comes at a cost.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Defenders
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes masks and capes for her and Pandy, they become the dollhouse defenders and must save the Gabby Cats from Bad Guy CatRat! In the Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song about her garden magic!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Mixed-Up Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a snow globe shaped like the dollhouse, she notices the rooms inside are all cattywampus and in the wrong place. After a series of wacky misadventures that result in CatRat becoming a craft version of himself, Gabby figures out they need to fix the dollhouse globe to return everything back to normal.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the “butt xylophone” couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Pirates
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a pirate treasure map in the shape of the dollhouse (a piece of it has been torn off). This must mean it’s time for a pirate treasure hunt in the dollhouse! Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many “lands” of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - MerCat Gets Her Sparkle Back
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes beakers filled with a magical potion, they conjure up an invite for Spa Day at the dollhouse! However, while decorating for MerCat's favorite day of the year, MerCat accidentally loses her color and sparkle. Gabby and Pandy must help her get her sparkle back for the big Spa Day party!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Monster Machine
programme.desc: The annual baby pageant approaches, but Staci’s plan to win may have a negative effect

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Power Outage Part 3 + 4
programme.desc: Power Outage – Part 3: Escape from Scare School Things worsen when a leprechaun, Razznik, steals the magical cleptor that now holds all of Scare School's powers. Power Outage – Part 4: The Final Battle On a hunt for ghostly powers, the evil leprechaun orders Deedstown to hand over Casper's uncles, OR ELSE.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Ghost In The Gallery Wart On The Nose
programme.desc: Ghost in the Gallery After hearing reports of a ghost stealing artwork from the Deedstown Museum, Casper becomes convinced that his uncles are involved. Wart on the Nose When Professor Thurdigree Burns comes down with dragon flu, Casper, Mantha and Ra are tasked with finding a cure.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lola's nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas' diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - The Bear Necessities
programme.desc: When their favorite zoo visitor loses his teddy bear, our gang goes on a wild adventure through New York City to return it to him - and in the process Marty learns that some things in life can't be found in an instruction manual.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Melman at the Movies
programme.desc: Melman finds a lucky flower and is convinced that today will be his Best Day Ever! But when a series of unlucky events threaten to ruin his day, he’s faced with the choice to drown in his sorrows or “take back the day”!

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spark Bees Best in Show
programme.desc: The kids scare away a swarm of bees. But when they realize bees make the flowers happy, they hatch a plan to get them back! When Scallop makes a bad choice, Kelp helps her learn from her mistakes.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Superfan Barb
programme.desc: Kelp and the rest of his friends put on a game of rainbow ball, but Kelp begins to wonder how well his special spark can help him truly measure up to his favorite player. When the underwater friends meet someone new, they’re reminded that their differences make them unique.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Pupcakes \ Stink or Swim
programme.desc: When Tag discovers that Scooch is a great baker, she encourages him to start a pupcake stand. But when Tag rounds up more customers than Scooch is prepared to handle, Scooch can’t keep up with the demand. \ Tag and Scooch’s race to pick up the most trash on Pawston Beach is thwarted by Frank and Beans, who just want to make more of a mess.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - A Ball-For-All
programme.desc: It's Ball-entine’s Day, the day when the dogs of Pawston show their affection for each other by exchanging balls. But unfortunately, the town is fresh out, so Tag and Scooch set sail for Ball Island. \ If Tag and Scooch want to leave Ball Island with the balls they chose for their family, they must earn them by proving themselves ball-worthy, through a series of challenges from The Fetcher.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Welcome to Harmony Harbor
programme.desc: Ari moves in to Harmony Harbor, but notices something strange involving a group of kids, a Noodle Truck chef and her pet squirrel. After Ari discovers the secret of Team Zenko Go, he asks to join the crew. But first he must learn the importance of teamwork.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Delivery Disaster Slippery Business
programme.desc: When Donna's delivery truck breaks down, it's up to the crew to help Donna continue delivering packages to Harmony Harbor's residents. When the crew takes on a mission to rescue a lost pet, Ellie must face her fears in order to help save the day.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - King Burple
programme.desc: After Burple and Cutter crash-land in a village of tiny dragons, Burple's unintentional act of courage leads the locals to crown him as their king.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Charged Up
programme.desc: Magnus's superpowered mechano-dragon threatens to replace the Riders. But when it spirals out of control, the town's real heroes have to step up!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! programme.title: The Mr. Peabody And Sherman Show S1 - Sherman Exchange ProgramCharles Dickens
programme.desc: Sherman trades places with a kid Emperor and learns that being king is harder than it seems and Peabody's new co-host is out of control

programme.title: The Mr. Peabody And Sherman Show S1 - Ruff GuyzGeorge Crum
programme.desc: When Peabody gets carried away trying to create the perfect band using historical friends, Sherman must stop him from becoming a music monster

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Stories
programme.desc: Artephius and the orphans are alone in town when a Celtic thunder god demands to be let into the treasure house – or he will destroy San Lorenzo!

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Sphere
programme.desc: A piece of treasure that belongs to the Mole King is missing, and he won't give it up unless Puss helps him reunite with his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Bridge Over Troubled Lava
programme.desc: The whole gang escapes pursing Guards, battles flowing lava, and survives crumbling caves and pillars to finally make it back to the Forbidden City. Xiao is ready to escape the palace, but Shi Long has other plans for her.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - House of Flying Pandas
programme.desc: The gang learns of even bigger and direr forces working against the Empress and the Kingdom of China, and must come up with a plan to put a stop to it before it is too late.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales S3 - The Healing Tree
programme.desc: While riding back to Miradero, the girls get lost -- and Abigail's horse gets bitten by a snake! Can an old friend's skills help save the day?

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales S3 - The Mystery of the Golden Unicorn
programme.desc: After finding a majestic horse in the wild, Lucky and the girls set out to solve the mystery of where she came from -- and where she truly belongs.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Rise of Jörmungandr
programme.desc: Tom and the riders must finally overcome their differences and come together as a team to survive the Dark Realm.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - How to Train Jörmungandr
programme.desc: Tom attempts to defeat the World Serpent by emulating Hiccup.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - The Great Foster Fake-Out
programme.desc: Tom and the dragon riders foster displaced Hidden Realm dragons in Rakke Town but things get complicated when Mr. Rakke makes a surprise visit.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Bombastic Blathering of Brainy Blabulous
programme.desc: When Krupp transfers to another school, George and Harold follow, only to find a bizarro version of Jerome Horwitz Elementary, where the teachers are nice and the kids are well-behaved. But no one's having any fun! George and Harold want to right this wrong with pranks and comics. But Krupp enlists Mr. Neamer (bizarro Meaner), who then super-enlargers his brain and becomes Brainy Blabulous, in order to stop the subversion of authority.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Crazy Caustic Spray of the Contagious Cruelius Sneezer
programme.desc: In order to spice up their field trip to Romeinday (an ancient Rome reenactment park), George and Harold trick Melvin into turning the bus into a time machine so they can travel to actual ancient Rome and be gladiators. After offending Caesar with their comic, the emperor is accidentally turned into Cruelius Sneezer and pursues the school group with all his might.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Trashy Tale of the Tumultuous Tubbadump
programme.desc: In honor of Dump Day in Piqua- celebrating the creation of the dump - George and Harold try to earn extra credit by creating a trash-alanche. But Melvin creates an invention to suck all the trash into another dimension. The plan backfires when Tubbadump, a trash-covered monster, emerges from that dimension for revenge on the trashmakers.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - The Big Shine

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Ball in Cup
programme.desc: When Phil invents a simple new game called ball-in-cup, everyone except Hope, can't stop playing it. But just when Hope thinks she's rid the farm of the game, she finds herself addicted to the game worst of all.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Growing Paints
programme.desc: When Grug thinks his forehead looks too big in Ugga's family portrait, she strives to make the painting disappear.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Trading Up
programme.desc: Boss takes an overdue vacation day, and ends up teaching Tabitha the value of "trading up" valueless objects into something she actually wants, an electric scooter. However, a 5%er baby is in trouble and BB's field team has "got it under control"… or do they? Boss tries to juggle his Tabitha lessons with sneaking peeks at the mission in progress

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.
